verdict.rationale: The GitHub README describes GraphQL (hoppscotch-gh-9) and full-duplex communication over a single TCP connection, which is WebSocket (hoppscotch-gh-4). That indicates non-REST protocol support for two of the four protocols in the story, but both are thin one-line descriptions with no docs or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: any evidence of gRPC support, any evidence of SSE support, in-depth first-party docs for GraphQL and WebSocket requests, independent or hands-on confirmation.
